integrity: Finite exhaustive configuration tests were run from the standalone package; all unbounded claims rely on the analytical proof and not these tests.
scientific_limitations: Independent site percolation on open three-row square strips only. The covariance sign is a thermodynamic limit. General or unlocated exact site-strip transfer-matrix results could imply parts of the finding; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Vacancy-corridor face spectrum and a unique cluster-density peak in three-row site percolation
